sentences.zh: 開寶四年八月癸卯，景星見。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Kaibao, eighth month, on the day guimao, the Auspicious Star appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Kaibao era, on the day guimao, an auspicious star appeared.

sentences.zh: 景德三年四月戊寅，周伯星見，出氐南騎官西一度，狀如半月，有芒角，煌煌然可以鑒物，曆庫樓東，八月，隨天輪入濁，十一月，復見在氐。

translations.literal: Third year of Jingde, fourth month, on the day wuyin, the Zhou Bo Star appeared, emerging one degree west of the Cavalry Official south of Di; shaped like a half moon, with rays and horns, brilliantly able to mirror objects; passed east of Storehouse Wall; in the eighth month, following the celestial wheel it entered the turbid; in the eleventh month, it appeared again in Di.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the third year of the Jingde era, on the day wuyin, the Zhou Bo star appeared, emerging one degree west of the Cavalry Official south of Di. It was shaped like a half moon, with rays and horns, and shone so brightly it could reflect objects. It passed east of Storehouse Wall. In the eighth month it entered the turbid zone along with the celestial wheel. In the eleventh month it appeared again in Di.

sentences.zh: 自是常以十一月辰見東方，八月西南入濁。

translations.literal: From this time it was regularly seen in the east at the chen watch in the eleventh month, and entered the turbid to the southwest in the eighth month.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter it was regularly seen in the east at dawn during the eleventh month, and entered the turbid zone to the southwest in the eighth month.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符七年正月己酉，含譽星見。

sentences.zh: 其年九月丙戌，又見，似彗有尾而不長。

translations.idiomatic: That same year, in the ninth month on the day bingxu, it appeared again, resembling a comet with a tail that was not long.

sentences.zh: 開寶八年六月甲子，出柳，長四丈，辰見東方，西南指，曆輿鬼至東壁，凡十一舍，八十三日而滅。

translations.literal: Eighth year of Kaibao, sixth month, on the day jiazi, it emerged in Willow, four zhang long; seen at the chen watch in the east, pointing southwest; passed through Chariot and Ghost to Eastern Wall—in all eleven lodges; after eighty-three days it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Kaibao era, on the day jiazi, a comet emerged in Willow, four zhang in length. It was seen at dawn in the east, pointing southwest, and passed through Chariot and Ghost to Eastern Wall—a total of eleven lodges—before vanishing after eighty-three days.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年七月戊子，又出東井積水西，青白色，光芒漸長，辰見東北，旬日夕見西北，曆右攝提，凡三十日至亢沒。

translations.literal: Second year of Duangong, seventh month, on the day wuzi, it again emerged west of the Accumulated Water of Eastern Well; bluish-white in color, its rays gradually lengthened; seen at the chen watch in the northeast; after ten days seen in the northwest at dusk; passed through Right Arrayed Timbers—in all thirty days until it set in Kang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Duangong era, on the day wuzi, it again emerged west of the Accumulated Water of Eastern Well. It was bluish-white, its rays gradually lengthening. It was seen at dawn in the northeast; after ten days it was seen in the northwest at dusk. It passed through Right Arrayed Timbers and, in thirty days altogether, set in Kang.

sentences.zh: 咸平元年正月甲申，又出營室北，光芒尺餘，至丁酉，凡十四日滅。

translations.literal: First year of Xianping, first month, on the day jiashen, it again emerged north of Encampment; its rays were over a foot long; until the day dingyou—in all fourteen days—it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of the Xianping era, on the day jiashen, it again emerged north of Encampment, its rays more than a foot long. By the day dingyou, after fourteen days in all, it vanished.

sentences.zh: 六年十一月辛亥，旄頭犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: Sixth year of Xianping, eleventh month, on the day xinhai, Mao Tou violated Chariot and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year of the Xianping era, on the day xinhai, Mao Tou encroached upon Chariot and Ghost.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，有彗孛于井、鬼，大如杯，色青白，光芒四尺餘，曆五諸侯及五車入參，凡三十餘日沒。

translations.literal: On the day jiayin, there was a broom star in Well and Ghost, as large as a cup, bluish-white in color, with rays over four feet long; passed through the Five Feudal Lords and Five Chariots and entered Shen—in all over thirty days until it set.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiayin, a broom star appeared in Well and Ghost, as large as a cup and bluish-white in color, with rays more than four feet long. It passed through the Five Feudal Lords and Five Chariots and entered Shen, and after more than thirty days in all it set.

sentences.zh: 天禧二年六月辛亥，彗出北斗魁第二星東北，長三尺許，與北斗第一星齊，北行經天牢，拂文昌，長三尺餘，曆紫微、三台、軒轅速行而西，至七星，凡三十七日沒。

translations.literal: Second year of Tianxi, sixth month, on the day xinhai, a comet emerged northeast of the second star of the Dipper's Scepter, about three feet long, level with the first star of the Dipper; traveling north it passed through Celestial Prison, brushed Literary Glory, lengthened to over three feet, passed through Purple Palace, Three Steps, and Charioteer, rapidly moving west to Seven Stars—in all thirty-seven days until it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Tianxi era, on the day xinhai, a comet emerged northeast of the second star of the Dipper's Scepter, about three feet long and level with the Dipper's first star. Traveling north, it passed through Celestial Prison and brushed Literary Glory, its tail lengthening to more than three feet. It passed through Purple Palace, Three Steps, and Charioteer, moving rapidly west to Seven Stars, and set after thirty-seven days in all.

sentences.zh: 景祐元年八月壬戌夜，有星孛于張、翼，長七尺，闊五寸，十二日而沒。

translations.literal: First year of Jingyou, eighth month, on the night of the day renxu, there was a broom star in Extended Net and Wings, seven feet long and five inches wide; after twelve days it set.
translations.idiomatic: On the night of the day renxu in the eighth month of the first year of the Jingyou era, a broom star appeared in Extended Net and Wings, seven feet long and five inches wide. After twelve days it set.

sentences.zh: 十二月己未夜，有星出外屏，有芒氣。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, on the night of the day jiwei, a star emerged from Outer Screen, with rayed vapors.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on the night of the day jiwei, a star emerged from Outer Screen with rayed vapors.

sentences.zh: 皇祐元年二月丁卯，彗出虛，晨見東方，西南指，曆紫微至婁，凡一百一十四日而沒。

translations.literal: First year of Huangyou, second month, on the day dingmao, a comet emerged in Emptiness; seen at dawn in the east, pointing southwest; passed through Purple Palace to Lou—in all one hundred fourteen days until it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the first year of the Huangyou era, on the day dingmao, a comet emerged in Emptiness. It was seen at dawn in the east, pointing southwest, and passed through Purple Palace to Lou—a total of one hundred fourteen days—before it set.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐元年七月，彗出紫微，曆七星，其色白，長丈餘，至八月癸亥滅。

translations.literal: First year of Jiayou, seventh month, a comet emerged in Purple Palace, passed through Seven Stars; its color was white, over one zhang long; until the eighth month, day guihai, it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the first year of the Jiayou era, a comet emerged in Purple Palace and passed through Seven Stars. It was white in color and more than one zhang long, and by the day guihai in the eighth month it had vanished.

sentences.zh: 治平三年三月己未，彗出營室，晨見東方，長七尺許，西南指危洎墳墓，漸東速行，近日而伏。

translations.literal: Third year of Zhiping, third month, on the day jiwei, a comet emerged in Encampment; seen at dawn in the east, about seven feet long, pointing southwest toward Rooftop and Tomb and Graves; gradually moving east with increasing speed, it approached the sun and concealed itself.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Zhiping era, on the day jiwei, a comet emerged in Encampment. Seen at dawn in the east, it was about seven feet long and pointed southwest toward Rooftop and Tomb and Graves. Moving gradually east with increasing speed, it drew near the sun and concealed itself.

sentences.zh: 至辛巳，夕見西南，北有星，無芒彗，益東方，別有白氣一，闊三尺許，貫紫微極星並房宿，首尾入濁，益東行，曆文昌、北斗貫尾。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, it was seen at dusk in the southwest; to the north was a star without rayed cometary tail; farther east, separately there was one white vapor about three feet wide, piercing Purple Palace's Pole Star and Room together; both ends entered the turbid; moving farther east, it passed through Literary Glory and pierced the tail of the Northern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi it was seen in the southwest at dusk. To the north was a star with no cometary rays; farther east, a separate white vapor about three feet wide pierced Purple Palace's Pole Star and Room, both ends entering the turbid zone. Moving farther east, it passed through Literary Glory and pierced the tail of the Northern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 至壬午，星復有芒彗，長丈餘，闊三尺餘，東北指，曆五車，白氣爲岐橫天，貫北河、五諸侯、軒轅、太微五帝坐內五諸侯及角、亢、氐、房宿。

translations.literal: On the day renwu, the star again had rayed cometary tail, over one zhang long and more than three feet wide, pointing northeast; passed through Five Chariots; the white vapor forked across the sky, piercing Northern River, Five Feudal Lords, Charioteer, the Five Feudal Lords within the Five Emperors' Seat of Supreme Palace, and the lodges Horn, Neck, Base, and Room.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renwu the star again showed cometary rays, more than one zhang long and over three feet wide, pointing northeast. It passed through Five Chariots, while the white vapor forked across the sky, piercing Northern River, Five Feudal Lords, Charioteer, the Five Feudal Lords within the Five Emperors' Seat of Supreme Palace, and the lodges Horn, Neck, Base, and Room.

sentences.zh: 癸未，彗長丈五尺，星有彗氣如一升器，曆營宿至張，凡一十四舍，積六十七日，星氣孛皆滅。

translations.literal: On the day guiwei, the comet was one zhang and five feet long; the star had cometary vapor like a one-sheng vessel; passed through the Encampment lodge to Extended Net—in all fourteen lodges, accumulating sixty-seven days; the star's vapors and broom tail all vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guiwei the comet was one zhang and five feet long, and the star's cometary vapor resembled a one-sheng measure. It passed from the Encampment lodge to Extended Net—a total of fourteen lodges over sixty-seven days—until the star's vapors and broom tail all vanished.

sentences.zh: 熙寧八年十月乙未，星出軫度中，如填，青白。

translations.literal: Eighth year of Xining, tenth month, on the day yiwei, a star emerged within the Chariot Shaft lodge-degree, like Fill Star, bluish-white.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month of the eighth year of the Xining era, on the day yiwei, a star emerged within the Chariot Shaft lodge-degree, resembling Saturn and bluish-white in color.

sentences.zh: 丙申，西北生光芒，長三尺，斜指軫，若彗。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, in the northwest rays emerged, three feet long, slanting toward Chariot Shaft, like a comet.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen rays emerged in the northwest, three feet long and slanting toward Chariot Shaft, like a comet.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，光芒長五尺。

translations.literal: On the day dingyou, the rays were five feet long.
translations.idiomatic: On the day dingyou the rays were five feet long.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，長七尺，斜指左轄，至丁未，入濁不見。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, seven feet long, slanting toward Left Yoke; until the day dingwei it entered the turbid and was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu it was seven feet long and slanted toward Left Yoke. By the day dingwei it had entered the turbid zone and was no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 元豐三年七月癸未，彗出西北太微垣郎位南，白氣長一丈，斜指東南，在軫度中。

translations.literal: Third year of Yuanfeng, seventh month, on the day guiwei, a comet emerged south of the Gentleman-in-Waiting Seat in the northwest Supreme Palace Enclosure; white vapor one zhang long, slanting toward the southeast, within the Chariot Shaft lodge-degree.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year of the Yuanfeng era, on the day guiwei, a comet emerged south of the Gentleman-in-Waiting Seat in the northwest Supreme Palace Enclosure. Its white vapor was one zhang long, slanting toward the southeast within the Chariot Shaft lodge-degree.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，向西北行，在翼度中。

translations.literal: On the day bingxu, it traveled toward the northwest, within the Wings lodge-degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingxu it traveled northwest, within the Wings lodge-degree.

sentences.zh: 戊子，長三尺，斜穿郎位。

translations.literal: On the day wuzi, three feet long, obliquely piercing the Gentleman-in-Waiting Seat.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuzi it was three feet long and obliquely pierced the Gentleman-in-Waiting Seat.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，犯軒轅，至丁酉入濁不見。

translations.literal: On the day guimao, it violated Charioteer; until the day dingyou it entered the turbid and was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guimao it encroached upon Charioteer, and by the day dingyou it had entered the turbid zone and was no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 庚子晨，復出於張度中。

translations.literal: On the morning of the day gengzi, it again emerged within the Extended Net lodge-degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the morning of the day gengzi it reappeared within the Extended Net lodge-degree.

sentences.zh: 至戊子，凡三十有六日，沒不見。

translations.literal: Until the day wuzi, in all thirty-six days, it set and was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: By the day wuzi, after thirty-six days in all, it set and was no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 紹聖四年八月己酉，彗出氐度中，如填，有光，色白，氣長三丈，斜指天市左星，九月壬子，光芒長五尺，入天市垣。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Shaosheng, eighth month, on the day jiyou, a comet emerged within the Base lodge-degree, like Fill Star, with light, white in color, vapor three zhang long, slanting toward the left star of Celestial Market; ninth month, day renzi, rays five feet long, entered the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fourth year of the Shaosheng era, on the day jiyou, a comet emerged within the Base lodge-degree, resembling Saturn with a bright white glow and vapor three zhang long slanting toward the left star of Celestial Market. In the ninth month on the day renzi its rays were five feet long as it entered the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己未，犯天市垣宦者。

translations.literal: On the day jiwei, it violated the Eunuch of the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiwei it encroached upon the Eunuch star of the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 庚申，犯天市垣帝坐。

translations.literal: On the day gengshen, it violated the Emperor's Seat of the Celestial Market Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On the day gengshen it encroached upon the Emperor's Seat of the Celestial Market Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，沒不見。

translations.literal: On the day wuchen, it set and was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuchen it set and was no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 崇寧五年正月戊戌，彗出西方，如杯口大，光芒散出如碎星，長六丈，闊三尺，斜指東北，自奎宿貫婁、胃、昴、畢，後入濁不見。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Chongning, first month, on the day wuxu, a comet emerged in the west, as large as a cup mouth; rays scattered outward like broken stars, six zhang long and three feet wide, slanting toward the northeast; from the Legs lodge it pierced Lou, Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net, afterward entering the turbid and no longer being seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fifth year of the Chongning era, on the day wuxu, a comet emerged in the west as large as a cup mouth. Its rays scattered outward like broken stars, six zhang long and three feet wide, slanting northeast from the Legs lodge through Lou, Stomach, Hairy Head, and Net before entering the turbid zone and disappearing.

sentences.zh: 大觀四年五月丁未，彗出奎、婁，光芒長六尺，北行入紫微垣，至西北入濁不見。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Daguan, fifth month, on the day dingwei, a comet emerged in Legs and Lou; rays six feet long; traveling north it entered the Purple Palace Enclosure; until the northwest it entered the turbid and was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year of the Daguan era, on the day dingwei, a comet emerged in Legs and Lou with rays six feet long. Traveling north it entered the Purple Palace Enclosure and, reaching the northwest, entered the turbid zone and was no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 靖康元年六月壬戌，彗出紫微垣。

translations.literal: First year of Jingkang, sixth month, on the day renxu, a comet emerged from the Purple Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Jingkang era, on the day renxu, a comet emerged from the Purple Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 紹興元年九月，彗星見。

translations.literal: First year of Shaoxing, ninth month, a comet appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the first year of the Shaoxing era, a comet appeared.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊寅、二年八月甲寅，見於胃。

translations.literal: Twelfth month, day wuyin; second year, eighth month, day jiayin—it was seen in Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month on the day wuyin of the first year, and in the eighth month on the day jiayin of the second year, it was seen in Stomach.

sentences.zh: 丙辰，行犯土司空，至九月甲戌始滅。

translations.literal: On the day bingchen, traveling it violated Earth Grand Marshal; until the ninth month, day jiaxu, it first vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingchen, as it moved it encroached upon Earth Grand Marshal, and it did not vanish until the day jiaxu in the ninth month.

sentences.zh: 十五年四月戊寅，彗星見東方。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year of Shaoxing, fourth month, on the day wuyin, a comet appeared in the east.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifteenth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day wuyin, a comet appeared in the east.

sentences.zh: 丙申，復見於參度。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, it again appeared within the Three Stars lodge-degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen it reappeared within the Three Stars lodge-degree.

sentences.zh: 五月丁巳，化爲客星，其色青白。

translations.literal: Fifth month, day dingsi, it transformed into a guest star, bluish-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month on the day dingsi it transformed into a guest star, bluish-white in color.

sentences.zh: 壬戌，留守張，至六月丁亥乃消。

translations.literal: On the day renxu, it remained at Extended Net; until the sixth month, day dinghai, it finally dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: On the day renxu it remained at Extended Net, and it did not finally dissipate until the day dinghai in the sixth month.

sentences.zh: 十六年十一月庚寅，彗星見西南危宿。

translations.literal: Sixteenth year of Shaoxing, eleventh month, on the day gengyin, a comet appeared southwest at Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixteenth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day gengyin, a comet appeared southwest at Rooftop.

sentences.zh: 二十六年七月丙午，彗星見東井，約長一丈，光芒二尺。

translations.literal: Twenty-sixth year of Shaoxing, seventh month, on the day bingwu, a comet appeared at Eastern Well, about one zhang long with rays two feet long.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twenty-sixth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day bingwu, a comet appeared at Eastern Well, about one zhang long with rays two feet long.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，又犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: On the day guichou, it again violated Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: On the day guichou it again encroached upon Five Feudal Lords.

sentences.zh: 三十一年六月己巳，彗星見北斗天權星東北，太史妄稱爲含譽。

translations.literal: Thirty-first year of Shaoxing, sixth month, on the day jisi, a comet appeared northeast of the Northern Dipper's Balance star; the Grand Clerk falsely called it Holding Glory.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the thirty-first year of the Shaoxing era, on the day jisi, a comet appeared northeast of the Northern Dipper's Balance star. The Grand Clerk wrongly identified it as Holding Glory.

sentences.zh: 淳熙二年七月辛丑，有星孛于西北方，當紫微垣外七公之上，小如熒惑，森然蓬孛，至丙午始消。

translations.literal: Second year of Chunxi, seventh month, on the day xinchou, there was a broom star in the northwest, above the Seven Lords outside the Purple Palace Enclosure, small like Sparkling Deluder, bristling like a broom star; until the day bingwu it first dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Chunxi era, on the day xinchou, a broom star appeared in the northwest above the Seven Lords outside the Purple Palace Enclosure. It was as small as Mars and bristled like a broom star, and it did not dissipate until the day bingwu.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十五年八月甲午，彗星見右攝提，光芒三尺餘，體類歲星，凡兩月，曆氐、房、心乃沒。

translations.literal: Fifteenth year of Jiading, eighth month, on the day jiawu, a comet appeared at Right Arrayed Timbers; rays more than three feet long; its body resembled Year Star; in all two months it passed through Base, Room, and Heart and then set.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the fifteenth year of the Jiading era, on the day jiawu, a comet appeared at Right Arrayed Timbers with rays more than three feet long and a body resembling Jupiter. Over two months it passed through Base, Room, and Heart and then set.

sentences.zh: 紹定三年十一月丁酉，有星孛於天市垣屠肆星之下，明年二月壬午乃消。

translations.literal: Third year of Shaoding, eleventh month, on the day dingyou, there was a broom star below the Butcher's Shop star of the Celestial Market Enclosure; the following year, second month, day renwu, it finally dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of the Shaoding era, on the day dingyou, a broom star appeared below the Butcher's Shop star of the Celestial Market Enclosure. It did not finally dissipate until the day renwu in the second month of the following year.

sentences.zh: 五年閏九月，彗星見東方，十月己未始消。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Shaoding, intercalary ninth month, a comet appeared in the east; tenth month, day jiwei, it first dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary ninth month of the fifth year of the Shaoding era a comet appeared in the east, and it first dissipated on the day jiwei in the tenth month.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年正月辛未，彗星見於室，至三月辛未乃消。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Jiaxi, first month, on the day xinwei, a comet appeared in Encampment; until the third month, day xinwei, it finally dissipated.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of the Jiaxi era, on the day xinwei, a comet appeared in Encampment, and it did not finally dissipate until the day xinwei in the third month.

sentences.zh: 景定五年七月甲戌，彗星見於柳，芒角燭天，長十餘丈，日高方斂，凡月餘，己卯，退行，見於輿鬼。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Jingding, seventh month, on the day jiaxu, a comet appeared in Willow; its rays and horns lit the sky, over ten zhang long; only when the sun was high did they diminish; in all over a month; on the day jimao it retrograded and appeared in Chariot and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year of the Jingding era, on the day jiaxu, a comet appeared in Willow with rays and horns that lit the sky, more than ten zhang long, diminishing only when the sun stood high. After more than a month, on the day jimao it retrograded and appeared in Chariot and Ghost.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，在井。

translations.literal: On the day xinsi, it was in Well.
translations.idiomatic: On the day xinsi it was in Well.

sentences.zh: 丙申，見於參。

translations.literal: On the day bingshen, it appeared in Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: On the day bingshen it appeared in Three Stars.

sentences.zh: 戊戌，在參宿度內。

translations.literal: On the day wuxu, it was within the Three Stars lodge-degree.
translations.idiomatic: On the day wuxu it was within the Three Stars lodge-degree.

sentences.zh: 八月末，光芒稍減，凡四月乃滅。

translations.literal: At the end of the eighth month the rays slightly diminished; in all after four months it vanished.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of the eighth month its rays diminished slightly, and after four months in all it vanished.

sentences.zh: 建隆二年十二月己酉，出天市垣宗人星東，微有芒彗，三年正月辛未，西南行入氐宿，二月癸丑，至七星沒。

translations.literal: Second year of Jianlong, twelfth month, on the day jiyou, it emerged east of the Clan Person star of the Celestial Market Enclosure, faintly with rayed cometary tail; third year, first month, day xinwei, traveling southwest it entered Base; second month, day guichou, until Seven Stars it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year of the Jianlong era, on the day jiyou, it emerged east of the Clan Person star of the Celestial Market Enclosure with a faint cometary tail. In the first month of the third year on the day xinwei it traveled southwest into Base, and on the day guichou in the second month it set at Seven Stars.

sentences.zh: 太平興國八年二月甲辰，出太微垣端門東，近屏星，北行。

translations.literal: Eighth year of Taiping Xingguo, second month, on the day jiachen, it emerged east of the End Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, near Screen Star, traveling north.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the eighth year of the Taiping Xingguo era, on the day jiachen, it emerged east of the End Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, near Screen Star, and traveled north.

sentences.zh: 端拱二年七月丁亥，出北河星西北，稍暗，微有芒彗，指西南。

translations.literal: Second year of Duangong, seventh month, on the day dinghai, it emerged northwest of the Northern River star, somewhat dim, faintly with rayed cometary tail, pointing southwest.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the second year of the Duangong era, on the day dinghai, it emerged northwest of the Northern River star, somewhat dim with a faint cometary tail, pointing southwest.

sentences.zh: 淳化元年正月辛巳，出軫宿，逆至張，七十日，經四十度乃不見。

translations.literal: First year of Chunhua, first month, on the day xinsi, it emerged at Chariot Shaft; retrograding to Extended Net, seventy days, passing forty degrees before it was no longer seen.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the first year of the Chunhua era, on the day xinsi, it emerged at Chariot Shaft. Retrograding to Extended Net, over seventy days and forty degrees, it was no longer visible.

sentences.zh: 景德二年八月甲辰，出紫微天棓側，孛孛然如粉絮，稍入垣內，曆御女、華蓋，凡十一日沒。

translations.literal: Second year of Jingde, eighth month, on the day jiachen, it emerged beside the Celestial Flail of Purple Palace, bristling like powdered fluff; slightly entering within the enclosure, passing through Serving Maid and Canopy—in all eleven days until it set.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the second year of the Jingde era, on the day jiachen, it emerged beside Purple Palace's Celestial Flail, bristling like powdered fluff. It entered slightly within the enclosure, passed through Serving Maid and Canopy, and set after eleven days in all.

sentences.zh: 三年三月乙巳，出東南方。

translations.literal: Third year of Jingde, third month, on the day yisi, it emerged in the southeast.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the third year of the Jingde era, on the day yisi, it emerged in the southeast.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符四年正月丁丑，見南斗魁前。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, first month, on the day dingchou, it appeared before the Scepter of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year of the Dazhong Xiangfu era, on the day dingchou, it appeared before the Scepter of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 天禧五年四月丙辰，出軒轅前星西北，大如桃，速行，經軒轅大星入太微垣，掩右執法，犯次將，曆屏星西北，凡七十五日，入濁沒。

translations.literal: Fifth year of Tianxi, fourth month, on the day bingchen, it emerged northwest of Charioteer's Front Star, as large as a peach, moving rapidly; passing Charioteer's great star it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, covering the Right Administrator of Law, violating the Second General, passing northwest of Screen Star—in all seventy-five days, entering the turbid and setting.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the fifth year of the Tianxi era, on the day bingchen, it emerged northwest of Charioteer's Front Star, as large as a peach and moving rapidly. Passing Charioteer's great star it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, obscuring the Right Administrator of Law and encroaching upon the Second General, then passed northwest of Screen Star. After seventy-five days in all it entered the turbid zone and set.

sentences.zh: 明道元年六月乙巳，出東北方，近濁，有芒彗。

translations.literal: First year of Mingdao, sixth month, on the day yisi, it emerged in the northeast, near the turbid, with rayed cometary tail.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of the Mingdao era, on the day yisi, it emerged in the northeast near the turbid zone with a cometary tail.

sentences.zh: 至丁巳，凡十三日沒。

translations.literal: Until the day dingsi, in all thirteen days it set.
translations.idiomatic: By the day dingsi, after thirteen days in all, it set.

sentences.zh: 至和元年五月己丑，出天關東南，可數寸，歲餘稍沒。

translations.literal: First year of Zhihe, fifth month, on the day jichou, it emerged southeast of Celestial Pass, several inches in size; after more than a year it gradually set.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year of the Zhihe era, on the day jichou, it emerged southeast of Celestial Pass, several inches across. After more than a year it gradually set.

sentences.zh: 熙寧二年六月丙辰，出箕度中，至七月丁卯，犯箕乃散。

translations.literal: Second year of Xining, sixth month, on the day bingchen, it emerged within the Winnowing Basket lodge-degree; until the seventh month, day dingmao, violating Winnowing Basket it scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the second year of the Xining era, on the day bingchen, it emerged within the Winnowing Basket lodge-degree. By the day dingmao in the seventh month, after encroaching upon Winnowing Basket, it scattered.

sentences.zh: 三年十一月丁未，出天囷。

translations.literal: Third year of Xining, eleventh month, on the day dingwei, it emerged at Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the third year of the Xining era, on the day dingwei, it emerged at Celestial Granary.

sentences.zh: 元祐六年十一月辛亥，出參度中，犯、掩廁星，壬子，犯九遊星，十二月癸酉，入奎，至七年三月辛亥乃散。

translations.literal: Sixth year of Yuanyou, eleventh month, on the day xinhai, it emerged within the Three Stars lodge-degree, violating and covering Privy Star; on the day renzi it violated Nine Tours Star; twelfth month, day guiyou, it entered Legs; until the seventh year, third month, day xinhai, it finally scattered.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the sixth year of the Yuanyou era, on the day xinhai, it emerged within the Three Stars lodge-degree, encroaching upon and obscuring Privy Star. On the day renzi it encroached upon Nine Tours Star; in the twelfth month on the day guiyou it entered Legs, and it did not finally scatter until the day xinhai in the third month of the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 紹興八年五月，守婁，魯分也。

translations.literal: Eighth year of Shaoxing, fifth month, it remained at Lou—the allotted region of Lu.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year of the Shaoxing era it remained at Lou, the allotted region of Lu.

sentences.zh: 九年二月壬申，守亢，陳分也。

translations.literal: Ninth year of Shaoxing, second month, on the day renshen, it remained at Neck—the allotted region of Chen.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the ninth year of the Shaoxing era, on the day renshen it remained at Neck, the allotted region of Chen.

sentences.zh: 乾道二年三月癸酉，出太微垣內五帝坐大星西，微小，色青白。

translations.literal: Second year of Qiandao, third month, on the day guiyou, it emerged west of the great star of the Five Emperors' Seat within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, very small, bluish-white in color.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the second year of the Qiandao era, on the day guiyou, it emerged west of the great star of the Five Emperors' Seat within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, very small and bluish-white in color.

sentences.zh: 淳熙八年六月己巳，出奎宿，犯傳舍星，至明年正月癸酉，凡一百八十五日始滅。

translations.literal: Eighth year of Chunxi, sixth month, on the day jisi, it emerged at the Legs lodge, violating Relay Inn star; until the following year, first month, day guiyou—in all one hundred eighty-five days—it first vanished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year of the Chunxi era, on the day jisi, it emerged at the Legs lodge and encroached upon Relay Inn star. It did not finally vanish until the day guiyou in the first month of the following year, one hundred eighty-five days in all.

sentences.zh: 嘉泰三年六月乙卯，出東南尾宿間，色青白，大如填星。

translations.literal: Third year of Jiatai, sixth month, on the day yimao, it emerged between Tail lodges in the southeast, bluish-white in color, as large as Fill Star.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the third year of the Jiatai era, on the day yimao, it emerged between the Tail lodges in the southeast, bluish-white in color and as large as Saturn.

sentences.zh: 甲子，守尾。

translations.literal: On the day jiazi, it remained at Tail.
translations.idiomatic: On the day jiazi it remained at Tail.

sentences.zh: 嘉定十七年六月己丑，犯尾宿。

translations.literal: Seventeenth year of Jiading, sixth month, on the day jichou, it violated the Tail lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the seventeenth year of the Jiading era, on the day jichou, it encroached upon the Tail lodge.

sentences.zh: 嘉熙四年七月庚寅，出尾宿。

translations.literal: Fourth year of Jiaxi, seventh month, on the day gengyin, it emerged at the Tail lodge.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year of the Jiaxi era, on the day gengyin, it emerged at the Tail lodge.
